description: This file defines the 'Registry' class within the Opencart	extbackslash System	extbackslash Engine namespace. It provides a registry pattern implementation with methods to get, set, check, and remove stored objects by key, utilizing PHP magic methods for property overloading.
published: Opencart	extbackslash System	extbackslash Engine	extbackslash Registry

classes.name: Registry
classes.description: A class implementing a registry pattern to store and retrieve objects by key within the system engine namespace.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to retrieve an object by key, delegates to the 'get' method.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Magic method to set an object by key, delegates to the 'set' method.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Magic method to check if a key exists, delegates to the 'has' method.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a stored object by its key, or null if not found.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores an object associated with a specified key.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the registry.

methods.name: unset
methods.description: Removes an object by its key from the registry.
